features.title: Armored firepower
features.text: Soldiers wear heavy armor and use area weapons to attack groups. Enemies that fail their saves become suppressed, slowing them and spoiling their aim.

features.title: Primary target
features.text: Before an area attack, make an extra Strike against the nearest creature in its cone or line, or the one nearest a burst's center.
